# IPCC — Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change

> The IPCC is the United Nations body for assessing the science related to climate change through assessment reports, special reports, and methodological guidance.

The IPCC provides policymakers with regular scientific assessments on climate change, its impacts and risks, and options for adaptation and mitigation. Its website centers on assessment reports, working groups, greenhouse gas inventory methodologies, governance documentation, activities, and multilingual access to key materials.

## Core Entry Points
- [Home](https://www.ipcc.ch/): Main entry point for IPCC reports, activities, news, and organizational resources.
- [Reports](https://www.ipcc.ch/reports/): Central hub for assessment reports, special reports, and methodology reports.
- [Synthesis Report](https://www.ipcc.ch/synthesis-report/): Overview page for the AR6 Synthesis Report: Climate Change 2023.
- [Working Groups](https://www.ipcc.ch/working-groups/): Gateway to Working Groups I, II, III, and the Task Force on Inventories.
- [Activities](https://www.ipcc.ch/activities/): Information on IPCC meetings, outreach, and ongoing panel activities.
- [News](https://www.ipcc.ch/news/): Official announcements, statements, updates, and media-related posts.

## Assessment Reports
- [Reports](https://www.ipcc.ch/reports/): Browse the full catalog of IPCC assessment, special, and methodology reports.
- [AR6 Synthesis Report](https://www.ipcc.ch/synthesis-report/): Final synthesis of findings from the Sixth Assessment Report cycle.
- [Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis](https://www.ipcc.ch/report/ar6/wg1/): Working Group I contribution on the physical science of climate change.
- [Climate Change 2022: Impacts, Adaptation and Vulnerability](https://www.ipcc.ch/report/ar6/wg2/): Working Group II contribution on impacts, adaptation, and vulnerability.
- [Climate Change 2022: Mitigation of Climate Change](https://www.ipcc.ch/report/ar6/wg3/): Working Group III contribution on mitigation pathways and policy-relevant options.
- [AR6 Reports Landing Page](https://www.ipcc.ch/assessment-report/ar6/): Overview of Sixth Assessment Report products and related materials.

## Special and Methodology Reports
- [Special Reports](https://www.ipcc.ch/reports/?category=special-reports): Collection of IPCC special reports across assessment cycles.
- [Methodology Reports](https://www.ipcc.ch/reports/?category=methodology-reports): Collection of greenhouse gas inventory methodology reports and guidance.
- [Global Warming of 1.5°C](https://www.ipcc.ch/sr15/): Special Report on impacts of 1.5°C warming and related pathways.
- [Climate Change and Land](https://www.ipcc.ch/srccl/): Special Report on climate change, desertification, land, and food security.
- [The Ocean and Cryosphere in a Changing Climate](https://www.ipcc.ch/srocc/): Special Report on ocean, coastal, polar, and cryosphere changes.
- [2019 Refinement to the 2006 IPCC Guidelines](https://www.ipcc.ch/report/2019-refinement-to-the-2006-ipcc-guidelines-for-national-greenhouse-gas-inventories/): Updated methodological guidance for national greenhouse gas inventories.

## Working Groups and Task Force
- [Working Groups](https://www.ipcc.ch/working-groups/): Overview of the scientific bodies that prepare IPCC assessment reports.
- [Working Group I](https://www.ipcc.ch/working-group/wg1/): Focuses on the physical science basis of climate change.
- [Working Group II](https://www.ipcc.ch/working-group/wg2/): Focuses on impacts, adaptation, and vulnerability.
- [Working Group III](https://www.ipcc.ch/working-group/wg3/): Focuses on mitigation of climate change.
- [Task Force on National Greenhouse Gas Inventories](https://www.ipcc.ch/working-group/tfi/): Develops methodologies for estimating and reporting greenhouse gas inventories.
- [Working Group and Task Force Resources](https://www.ipcc.ch/working-groups/): Starting point for group-specific pages and outputs.

## Data, Library, and Research Resources
- [Data](https://www.ipcc.ch/data/): Access to datasets, figures, and supporting data resources linked to IPCC outputs.
- [Library](https://www.ipcc.ch/library/): Searchable library of IPCC publications, reports, and related materials.
- [Documentation](https://www.ipcc.ch/documentation/): Official procedures, principles, and supporting organizational documents.
- [Links](https://www.ipcc.ch/links/): Curated external links to related climate and partner resources.
- [Help](https://www.ipcc.ch/help/): Guidance for using the site and accessing IPCC materials.

## Governance and Organization
- [About](https://www.ipcc.ch/about/): Mission, structure, history, and role of the IPCC.
- [Bureau Portal](https://www.ipcc.ch/bureau/): Information on the IPCC Bureau and bureau members.
- [Focal Points](https://www.ipcc.ch/focal-points/): National Focal Points and observer organization contact information.
- [Documentation](https://www.ipcc.ch/documentation/): Rules of procedure, principles, and governance documentation.
- [Activities](https://www.ipcc.ch/activities/): Institutional meetings, sessions, and process-related events.
- [About the IPCC](https://www.ipcc.ch/about/): Background on how the panel operates and produces assessments.

## Activities, Meetings, and Updates
- [Activities](https://www.ipcc.ch/activities/): Current and upcoming IPCC activities, meetings, and workshops.
- [News](https://www.ipcc.ch/news/): News releases, announcements, and updates from the IPCC.
- [Reports](https://www.ipcc.ch/reports/): Newly released and featured reports highlighted by the IPCC.
- [Synthesis Report](https://www.ipcc.ch/synthesis-report/): Featured AR6 synthesis materials and related updates.
- [Working Groups](https://www.ipcc.ch/working-groups/): Ongoing work by the scientific working groups and task force.

## Multilingual Resources
- [Arabic](https://www.ipcc.ch/languages-2/arabic/): Arabic-language access point for selected IPCC materials and resources.
- [Chinese](https://www.ipcc.ch/languages-2/chinese/): Chinese-language access point for selected IPCC materials and resources.
- [French](https://www.ipcc.ch/languages-2/francais/): French-language access point for selected IPCC materials and resources.
- [Russian](https://www.ipcc.ch/languages-2/russian/): Russian-language access point for selected IPCC materials and resources.
- [Spanish](https://www.ipcc.ch/languages-2/spanish/): Spanish-language access point for selected IPCC materials and resources.

## Support and Navigation
- [Help](https://www.ipcc.ch/help/): Assistance with navigating the website and finding IPCC content.
- [Links](https://www.ipcc.ch/links/): External resources relevant to climate science and IPCC users.
- [Library](https://www.ipcc.ch/library/): Reference access for publications and archived materials.
- [Data](https://www.ipcc.ch/data/): Supporting data and figure resources for report users.
- [Home](https://www.ipcc.ch/): Return to the main IPCC portal and featured content.
